1: // Minimal Cosmic Drift game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
10: 
11:   // Ship state
12:   const ship = {
13:     x: width / 2,
14:     y: height / 2,
15:     angle: 0,
16:     vx: 0,
17:     vy: 0,
18:     radius: 10,
19:   };
20: 
21:   // Game objects
22:   const asteroids = [];
23:   const orbs = [];
24:   let score = 0;
25:   let gameOver = false;
26: 
27:   // Settings
28:   const ASTEROID_COUNT = 8;
29:   const ORB_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 5000; // ms
30:   const THRUST = 0.1;
31:   const ROT_SPEED = 0.07;
32:   const MAX_SPEED = 5;
33: 
34:   // Star field
35:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
36:   const stars = [];
37:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
38:     stars.push({
39:       x: rand(0, width),
40:       y: rand(0, height),
41:       alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
42:     });
43:   }
44: 
45:   // Helpers
46:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
47:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
48: 
49:   // Initialize asteroids
50:   for (let i = 0; i < ASTEROID_COUNT; i++) {
51:     asteroids.push({
52:       x: rand(0, width),
53:       y: rand(0, height),
54:       vx: rand(-1, 1),
55:       vy: rand(-1, 1),
56:       radius: rand(15, 30),
57:     });
58:   }
59: 
60:   // Input handling
61:   const keys = {};
62:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
63:   // Simple sound factory
64:   function playTone(freq, duration = 0.1, type = 'sine') {
65:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
66:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
67:     osc.type = type;
68:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
69:     osc.connect(gain);
70:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
71:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
72:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
73:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
74:     osc.start();
75:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
76:   }
77:   function thrustSound() { playTone(300, 0.08, 'triangle'); }
78:   function collectSound() { playTone(600, 0.07, 'sawtooth'); }
79:   function crashSound() { playTone(150, 0.4, 'square'); }
80: 
81:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
82:     keys[e.key] = true;
83:     if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
84:       // resume context on first interaction
85:       if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
86:       thrustSound();
87:     }
88:   });
89:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
90: 
91:   // Orb spawning
92:   function spawnOrb() {
93:     orbs.push({
94:       x: rand(0, width),
95:       y: rand(0, height),
96:       radius: 6,
97:     });
98:   }
99:   setInterval(spawnOrb, ORB_SPAWN_INTERVAL);
100: 
101:   function update() {
102:     if (gameOver) return;
103:     // Ship controls
104:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.angle -= ROT_SPEED;
105:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.angle += ROT_SPEED;
106:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
107:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * THRUST;
108:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * THRUST;
109:     }
110:     // Clamp speed
111:     const speed = Math.hypot(ship.vx, ship.vy);
112:     if (speed > MAX_SPEED) {
113:       ship.vx *= MAX_SPEED / speed;
114:       ship.vy *= MAX_SPEED / speed;
115:     }
116:     // Move ship
117:     ship.x = (ship.x + ship.vx + width) % width;
118:     ship.y = (ship.y + ship.vy + height) % height;
119: 
120:     // Move asteroids
121:     for (const a of asteroids) {
122:       a.x = (a.x + a.vx + width) % width;
123:       a.y = (a.y + a.vy + height) % height;
124:     }
125: 
126:     // Twinkle stars
127:     for (const s of stars) {
128:       s.alpha += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02;
129:       if (s.alpha < 0.2) s.alpha = 0.2;
130:       if (s.alpha > 1) s.alpha = 1;
131:     }
132: 
133:     // Collision ship‑asteroid
134:     for (const a of asteroids) {
135:       if (dist(ship, a) < ship.radius + a.radius) {
136:         crashSound();
137:         gameOver = true;
138:         break;
139:       }
140:     }
141: 
142:     // Collision ship‑orb
143:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
144:       if (dist(ship, orbs[i]) < ship.radius + orbs[i].radius) {
145:         collectSound();
146:         score++;
147:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
148:       }
149:     }
150:   }
151: 
152:   function draw() {
153:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
154:     // Stars background with parallax
155:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
156:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
157:     // draw stars
158:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
159:     for (const s of stars) {
160:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
161:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 2, 2);
162:     }
163:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
164: 
165:     // Draw ship with gradient
166:     ctx.save();
167:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
168:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
169:     const grd = ctx.createLinearGradient(-12, 0, 12, 0);
170:     grd.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
171:     grd.addColorStop(1, '#060');
172:     ctx.fillStyle = grd;
173:     ctx.beginPath();
174:     ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
175:     ctx.lineTo(-8, -6);
176:     ctx.lineTo(-8, 6);
177:     ctx.closePath();
178:     ctx.fill();
179:     ctx.restore();
180:     ctx.save();
181:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
182:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
183:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
184:     ctx.beginPath();
185:     ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
186:     ctx.lineTo(-8, -6);
187:     ctx.lineTo(-8, 6);
188:     ctx.closePath();
189:     ctx.fill();
190:     ctx.restore();
191: 
192:     // Draw asteroids with irregular shapes
193:     for (const a of asteroids) {
194:       ctx.save();
195:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
196:       ctx.rotate(Math.random() * Math.PI * 2);
197:       ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
198:       ctx.beginPath();
199:       const sides = Math.floor(rand(5,9));
200:       for (let i=0;i<sides;i++){
201:         const angle = (i/sides)*Math.PI*2;
202:         const r = a.radius * (0.6 + Math.random()*0.4);
203:         ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(angle)*r, Math.sin(angle)*r);
204:       }
205:       ctx.closePath();
206:       ctx.fill();
207:       ctx.restore();
208:     }
209: 
210:     // Draw orbs
211:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
212:     for (const o of orbs) {
213:       ctx.beginPath();
214:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
215:       ctx.fill();
216:     }
217: 
218:     // Score
219:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
220:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
221:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
222: 
223:     if (gameOver) {
224:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
225:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
226:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
227:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
228:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
229:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
230:     }
231:   }
232: 
233:   function loop() {
234:     update();
235:     draw();
236:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
237:   }
238:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
239: })();

(End of file - total 239 lines)
